validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: strongly confirmed, real and well-documented, independent of the sheet's own wiki citation list (read for leads only, never cited, per standing rule 1 — the wiki's own footnotes point to intergas.kz/amangeldygas.kz pages that mostly 404 now, so I built fresh corroboration). FOUR genuinely independent origins agree in close detail on the physical pipe: (1) neftegaz.ru's technical field encyclopedia entry on the Amangeldinskoye field, (2) qsamruk.kz (Samruk-Kazyna's corporate portal for the Intergas Central Asia 'UMG Taraz' branch), (3) intergas.kz's own 'Общая информация' company page, and (4) a Kazinform news article (originally hosted on zakon.kz, now redirected to prg.kz — this is the SAME article the sheet's own wiki page cites as its ref for gas-production prospects in Zhambyl oblast, so this is 'engage what the sheet already cites' territory) — all describe a single 193-km trunk gas pipeline named 'Амангельды–КС-5 (Тараз)', commissioned 23 Oct 2003 (opened with then-president Nazarbayev in attendance per ru.wikipedia and prg.kz's 'с 2003 года, с момента ввода в эксплуатацию магистрального газопровода'), carrying gas from the Amangeldy gas-condensate field to compressor station KS-5 at Taraz. A FIFTH source — Intergas Central Asia's own official quarterly capacity filing 'Информация о наличии существующей мощности Магистральных Газоводов АО Интергаз Центральная Азия (по состоянию 01.01.2025г)' (intergas.kz/upload/userfiles/file/4 квартал 2024 года.pdf) — lists 'Амангельды-КС-5 Тараз' in its asset table with length 193 km, year 2003, and 2024 actual throughput of 494 mln m3 (60% of a 697 mln m3 design capacity), which both re-confirms the pipe is REAL and CURRENTLY OPERATING (data as of Jan 2025) and independently matches GEM's length/start year. url_verifier's automated content screen FAILs the token 'Амангельды' on this PDF despite a live 200 (a known false-negative class per its own docstring on PDFs — I downloaded it directly with curl -sk + a browser UA and ran `pdftotext -layout`, which cleanly shows the table row at line 112-114 of the extracted text: 'Амангельды-КС-5 / Тараз | 500 | 193 | 2003 | 697 | 494 | 60%'). GulfPub's crosswalk ('Amangeldy - Taraz', 193.12 km) independently matches too. CLASSIFICATION: correct — every primary source calls it a 'магистральный газопровод' (trunk/main gas pipeline), i.e. transmission, carrying processed gas ('Fuel'='Gas') from the Amangeldy field into the grid; not a gathering/feeder line despite the modest 193 km. DUPLICATE: checked against the full 39-pipeline Kazakhstan-gas roster — no other row is named Amangeldy or anything overlapping this corridor (Amangeldy field -> KS-5 -> Taraz); no double-count risk. LENGTH/START YEAR: both independently confirmed at 193 km / 2003 by 4+ sources above — no change needed. ATTRIBUTION (THE ACTUAL DEFECT): GEM records StartState/Province = 'Kostanay'. This is WRONG. Every one of the sources above states unambiguously that the Amangeldy gas-condensate field sits in the NORTH OF ZHAMBYL (Jambyl) REGION — neftegaz.ru: 'Амангельдинское газоконденсатное месторождение (АГКМ) расположено на севере Жамбылской области в 170 км к северу от Тараза' ('...located in the north of Zhambyl region, 170 km north of Taraz'); ru.wikipedia gives '165 km north of Taraz, Zhambyl Region'; prg.kz/Kazinform explicitly discusses the field as part of 'gas production prospects in Zhambyl oblast'. Kostanay is a different, non-adjacent region roughly 1,500 km to the north — this pipeline never comes near it. The likely source of the error is name confusion: there is a genuinely separate, unrelated 'Amangeldy District' (Amangeldi) in Kostanay Oblast (named for the same national hero, Amangeldy Imanov), and it appears to have been conflated with the Zhambyl-region gas field/settlement that actually anchors this pipeline. EndLocation/EndState/Province (Taraz / Jambyl) are correct and consistent with the corrected StartState/Province — this is an intra-Zhambyl-region pipeline, start to end. SPEC (diameter): GEM records Diameter=530 mm. Intergas Central Asia's own Q4-2024 capacity filing (same PDF as above) gives 'Диаметр условный, мм' = 500 for this exact line ('Амангельды-КС-5 / Тараз | 500 | 193 | 2003 | ...'). This is a material disagreement from the pipeline's own operator on an official regulatory filing — flagging as a spec concern rather than silently passing it, though I have only this one (highly authoritative, primary, dated) source for 500 mm and no second independent confirmation, so I am not proposing an auto-fill; recommend Update verify 500 mm vs 530 mm against a second source before changing the cell.
